tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī badzra yo gi n+yai/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// dwang ba'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// padma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags can skyes bu gdul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzad pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la phyag 'tshal// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyud chad med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rje'i gzhan gyi dbang du gyur nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen mo'i go 'phang thob par shog
/mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rnal 'byor ma dpal la// bstod pa'i tshig 'di bshes gnyen dam pa 'gas// yang yang bskul nas dge slong rgyud gsum pas/

kun dga' bzang po/ /mkhas pa'i chos grwa dpal ldan sa skyar bris// // ༄// sher phyin dkar mo la bstod pa// ༈ /oṃ na maḥshrī pra dzñā pa ra mi tā yai/ rab dkar padma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la// rnam dkar lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin// sprin dkar gangs ri sogs kyi mdangs 'phrog ma// 'od dkar ldan pas snying gi mun sel mdzod// ston zla rab rgyas ku mud dung dang chu shel gangs ri ltar dkar ma// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la dbang bsgyur rang rang skad du chos ston ma// rgya mtsho lta bur kun nas mi g.yo thugs rje'i rba rlabs rab 'khrigs ma// zol med gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal blo gros mchog stsol bcom ldan ma// chu skyes dkar po dri med steng na gser bzang ge sar g.yo ba'i rtser// ri bong 'dzin pa'i gdan gyi dbus na rdo rje skyil krung tshul gyis bzhugs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas g.yon dag na sher phyin rang bzhin posti gnyis// dkar dmar padma zung gi steng na legs 'dzin lha mchog khyod phyag 'tshal// chos kun rang bzhin gcig pa'i dbu ni bung ba ltar gnag skra yi mdzes// pa la sha ltar 'jam pa'i phyag ni sna tshogs gdu bu'i tshogs kyis spras// utpal lta bur rgyas pa'i spyan ni shin tu stug pa'i rji mas brgyan// skabs gsum bu mo'i dpal 'phrog khyod ni kho bo'i lhag pa'i lha yin grang*// dpral ba'i dbyes ni chung ba ma yin mdzod spu dung ltar g.yas su 'khyil// dag pa'i mchu ni dkar ba ma yin padma rā ga lta bur dmar// bzang po'i zhal ni khro ba ma yin zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan// rab mdzes sku ni drang ba ma yin cung zad g.yon du yo ba rgyal// gang sku snang ba'i yul las 'das kyang dbang po'i gzhu ltar snang ba'i sku// de gsung brjod pa'i sgra las 'das kyang yan lag drug cu'i sgra sgrogs gsung*// khyod thugs bsam pa'i yul las 'das kyang bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes thugs// sa dang shes rab zung du 'jug kyang shes rab rang bzhin lha mor 'dud// sra zhing mkhregs pa'i sa nyid min kyang yon tan rin chen phung po'i gzhi// brlan zhing gsher ba'i chu nyid min kyang 'gro ba'i sems kyi dri ma sbyangs// tsha zhing sreg pa'i me nyid min kyang sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas kun 'joms// yang zhing g.yo ba'i rlung nyid min kyang thugs rjes srid gsum smin mdzad rgyal// ma rig mun sel sher phyin lha mo la// mi gnas mya ngan 'das phyir gsol btab pas// mu mtha' med pa'i bde gshegs gsung rab la// me ltar 'bar ba'i blo gros bskyed du gsol// dpal rdo rje gur nas gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo la bstod pa bstod tshig rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos blo gros kyi bang mdzod las phyung ba'o//

// ༄// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i bstod pa// ༈ /na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ gang gi legs gsung nyin mor byed pa yis// bdag blo rmongs pa'i mun stug rab bsal te// ma nor gsung rab snang ba rgyas mdzad pa// 'jam dbyangs bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan mchod// zhe sdang mthar mdzad mi bskyod rdo rje'i dngos// gti mug rab spangs 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i sku// 'dod chags rnam dag yum dang rnam rol pa// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bde ba che la 'dud// rnam shes rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes dngos// gur gum mdog can bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs// thugs kyi rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis// 'gro ba'i zhe sdang sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs phung rnam dag me long ye shes dngos// ston zla'i mdog can rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// sku yi rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis// 'gro ba'i gti mug sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo// tshor phung rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes dngos// gser bzang mdog can skyob pa rin chen tog /yon tan rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis// 'gro ba'i ser sna sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo// 'du shes rnam dag sor rtog ye shes dngos// li khri'i mdog can 'dren pa 'od dpag med// gsung gi rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis// 'gro ba'i 'dod chags sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo// 'du byed rnam dag bya grub ye shes dngos// margad mdog can dpa' bo don yod grub// phrin las rigs kyi sprul pa dpag med kyis// 'gro ba'i phrag dog sbyong la phyag 'tshal lo// sa khams rnam dag thabs kyi phar phyin dngos// pad dkar mdog can yum mchog lha mo spyan// byams pa chen pos gdul bya ma lus pa'i// sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// chu khams rnam dag smon lam mthar phyin dngos// utpal mdog can rdo rje mā ma kī /snying rje chen pos 'gro ba ma lus pa'i// bsod nams rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// me khams rnam dag stobs kyi phar phyin dngos// padma dmar po'i mdog can gos dkar mo// dga' ba chen pos skye dgu ma lus pa// thugs rjes dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung khams rnam dag ye shes phar phyin dngos// gur gum rgyas pa'i mdog can sgrol ma che// btang snyoms chen pos sems can ma lus pa'i// gzung 'dzin gsod par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs kyi skye mched rnam dag sbyin pa'i dngos// gangs ri'i mdog can gzugs kyi rdo rje ma// 'khor lo'i rigs kyi rgyal ba ma lus rnams// gzugs kyi bde bas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// sgra yi skye mched rnam dag tshul khrims dngos// dbang sngon mdog can sgra yi rdo rje ma// rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyal ba ma lus rnams// sgra yi bde bas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// dri yi skye mched rnam dag bzod pa'i dngos// gser bsregs mdog mtshungs dri yi rdo rje ma// rin chen rigs kyi rgyal ba ma lus rnams// dri yi bde bas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// ro yi skye mched rnam dag brtson 'grus dngos// nyi ma'i mdog can ro yi rdo rje ma// padma'i rigs kyi rgyal ba ma lus rnams// ro yi bde bas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// reg bya'i skye mched rnam dag bsam gtan dngos// du ba'i mdog can reg bya rdo rje ma// ral gri'i rigs kyi rgyal ba ma lus rnams// reg bya'i bde bas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi skye mched rnam dag shes rab dngos// chu shel mdog can chos dbyings rdo rje ma// rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi rgyal ba rnams// chos khams bde bas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// ma dad smra dang phung po'i bdud sbyong zhing*// dad pa'i dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos// sprin bral nam mkha'i mdog can gshin rje'i gshed// bde gshegs 'gugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// le lo che dang nyon mongs bdud 'joms shing*// brtson 'grus dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos// rab dkar zla ba'i mdog can shes mthar byed// rgyal rnams bzhugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// brjed ngas blo dang 'chi bdag bdud 'dul zhing*// dran pa'i dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos// gzi brjid nyi ma'i mdog can pad mthar byed// bde gshegs 'ching bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam g.yengs lha yi bu yi bdud 'joms shing*// ting 'dzin dbang po rnam par dag pa'i dngos// rgya chen rgya mtsho'i mdog can bgegs mthar byed// bde gshegs mnyes par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// kun kyang sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang zhing*// rab mdzes dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras// sprul pa'i 'od zer dpag med 'phro ba can// longs spyod rdzogs sku che la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin yab yum sku// phan tshun zung 'jug sbyor ba'i rol pa yis// chags can skyes bu'i 'dod chags sbyong mdzad pa// kha sbyor dam pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten lha mi'i bde ba ma lus pas// dpe dang char yang gzhal bar mi nus pa'i// bde chen ye shes che la rtag rol pa// 'gyur med bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun rang bzhin rten 'byung zab mo'i dngos// 'od gsal zhi ba spros bral dam pa'i don// zab gsal gnyis med ye shes mchog brnyes pa// rang bzhin med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rje'i chu rlabs g.yo ba'i mthus// ma lus gdul bya'i bsam pa ji bzhin du// 'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin stsol mdzad pa// snying rjes yongs gang sku la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs sku yi sprul pa bsam yas kyis// bar dang phyogs dus rgyun chad yongs med par// rnam mang 'gro la phan pa mchog bsgrub pa'i// rgyun mi chad pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya chen thugs rjes gzhan la brtser dgongs nas// ji srid 'khor ba'i 'khrul pa ma zhig par// de srid mya ngan 'da' ba'i skabs med pa'i// 'gog pa med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' yas na// rab mdzes mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis rnams// rab mchog zhing gi dam pa 'jam dbyangs la// rab dkar dad pa'i sems kyis rgyas par 'bul// gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du// ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams// thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni// cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*// 'phags pa gzhan gyi dge ba gang mdzad pa// de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*// byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi// yid kyi rol pa dri med zla 'dras bsgrub// snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs// rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa yi// bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*// sems dpa' dam pa kun gyi phun tshogs gzhi// dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid// dam pa'i chos la rtag par skyabs su mchi// 'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing*// snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan// rab dga' la sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa'i// brtul bzhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur cing*// sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin// lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi// sems ni byang chub dam pa bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu// sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul// rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos// yang dag nyid du da ni gnas par bgyi// de ltar rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab dang*// ye shes gcig bsdus rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la// bdag gis mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// rnam dag dge ba'i bshes dang mjal gyur cig

/yongs 'dzin mkhas pas rjes su bzung gyur pas// 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal rang bzhin du// legs par rtogs nas de dag rab spangs te// ma nor thar ba'i lam du 'jug par shog /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor drin chen pha ma rnams// sdug bsngal chu bo chen pos khyer mthong ste// de rnams bsgral phyir snying rjes yid drangs nas// byang chub smon pa'i sems mchog bskyed par shog /lam gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims rnam gsum dang*// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel pa'i lam// pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs// rgya chen byang chub spyod la 'jug gyur cig /rgyal sras lam gyi rang rgyud dag pa'i tshe// tshul khrims dag cing 'dus pa'i rgyud la mkhas// de nyid bcu shes nyan thos spyod ldan pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mnyes byed shog /rmad byung dkyil 'khor chen por bum pa'i dbang*// rnam dag cho gas tshul bzhin bskur ba'i mthus// phung khams lha yi rnam par dag byas nas// rgya chen bskyed rim snod du 'gyur bar shog /lus kyi dbang po bha ga byang sems kyi// dkyil 'khor zab mor mchog dbang gsum bskur bas// rtsa thig rlung gsum bde bar byin brlabs nas// rdzogs rim zab mo'i snod du 'gyur bar shog /dbang dus cho gas thob dang khas blangs pa'i// bsrung dang mi spang bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams// tshul bzhin bsten pas nyes tshogs kun bcom nas// sngags kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag gyur cig /dbang gis mtshon pa'i yang dag lta ba'i don// chos rnams nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa// zab gsal gnyis med bde chen lhan cig skyes// dpal ldan bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par shog /tha mal rnam rtog kun bcom bskyed rim lam// chung dang bar ma chen po'i rim pa yis// bsnyen sgrub bzhi dang ting 'dzin rnam pa gsum// thun bzhir bsgoms pas lha snang mthar phyin shog

/lha sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nyid las// rgyal ba mchod dang sems can smin byed sogs// rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la rab 'bad pas// 'khor bar skye ba'i las kun dag par shog /chos kun rnam thar sgo gsum rang bzhin du// legs par rtogs nas spros bral dam pa'i don// ye shes tshogs kyi rnal 'byor legs bsgoms pas// nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i drwa ba zhi gyur cig /rnal 'byor 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshe// gnas rnams rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang*// bkod legs dbyings mdzes dam par 'grub pa'i rgyu// zhing kun dag pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /gzhi la gnas pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum// ji ltar grub bzhin lam du byas pa las// 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i lam// dang po sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /thabs shes sgyu ma bde ba'i rol pa las// shes rab padmar byang sems las 'khrungs pa// rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa las// bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin skye bar shog /'gro ba'i don du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// nam mkha'i khams kun khyab par rab spros nas// sna tshogs mdzad pas sems can smin byed pa// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /'od gsal bskyed pa thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*// sems rab brtan byed phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang*// dngos grub 'gugs pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// las rgyal mchog gi ting 'dzin mthar phyin shog /thun mtshams kun tu sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// sgo gsum dge ba'i spyod pa ci byed pa// de kun lha yi rol par shes byas pas// las dang spyod lam rnam par dag gyur cig /de ltar rim pa dang po'i rnal 'byor gyis// cir snang lha yi 'khor lor legs grub nas// lam bzang des kyang chog par mi 'dzin par// rdzogs rim zab mo'i lam la 'jug par shog /sna rtse gsum dang sbyor ba yan lag drug

/khyad par dngos po'i mtha' las rnam grol pa'i// man ngag rgyal po grol ba'i thig le la// thos bsam tshul gyis sgro 'dogs chod par shog /snying ga'i padmar 'od zer lnga ldan pa'i// mi shigs thig le 'dzag pa'i ngang tshul can// dngos po rkyen gyis mtha' yi de bzhin nyid// tshul bzhin bsgoms pas ye shes mchog thob shog /nor bu'i dbus su bde gshegs zhu ba'i rgyun// rdul mun snying stobs tshul du babs pa las// gsang ba'i thig le ye shes lnga yi dngos// spro bsdu'i bsgoms pas rjes dran mthar phyin shog /lus kyi gnas bzhir 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la// phyag rgya bzhi yi rang bzhin yig 'bru bzhi// rang bzhin bzlas pa'i tshul gyis goms byas pas// sprul pa'i thig le'i rnal 'byor 'grub gyur cig /yon tan kun kyi 'byung gnas mi shigs pa'i// thig le'i 'od kyis khams gsum ma lus pa// 'od gsal zhi ba'i dbyings su rab bsdus nas// slar yang zung 'jug snang ba rgyas byed shog /de ltar dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyed byed pa// thig le bzhi yi rnal 'byor dam pa dang*// rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa legs bsad pas// tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang thob shog /phyin ci log gi rnam pa kun dang bral// bsam dpyod las 'das mkha' bzhin dri ma med// gsal ba'i ye shes kun 'byung rnam rtog spangs// gting dpag dka' ba'i zab mo mthar phyin shog /chos dbyings las 'byung phyag rgya chen po'i sku// snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin can// rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs kun sbyang ba// yang dag gsal ba'i 'bras bu mngon 'gyur shog /de ltar zab gsal rang bzhin gnyis med can// dngos po kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid che// 'khor ba'i chos kyis rab tu ma zin pa// chos dbyings dam pa 'jam dbyangs myur thob shog /gnas skabs kun tu tshe ring nad med cing*// log 'tsho spangs pa'i phun tshogs 'byor par ldan// tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba'i nor ldan pas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog

/khyad par 'jam dbyangs mgon pos rjes bzung ba// shing rta'i srol 'byed grub chen ye shes zhabs// gang gis legs par bkra ba'i lam bzang 'di// ma nor phyogs mtha' kun tu rgyas byed shog /thugs rje che ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs dang*// rin chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rdo rje chos skyong rnams kyi mthu stobs kyis// bdag gi smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa'i dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid can la bstod cing smon lam du gsol ba'i rab tu byed pa shlau ka drug cu rtsa bdun pa 'di ni/ dad pa dang byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud phyug pa/ dge slong bsod nams rin chen gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos grub pa'i dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags kyi tshig dang spel te/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// //

༄// 'dod rgyal gyi bstod pa// ༈ /na maḥshrī ṭa ki rā dzā ya/ 'dod dgu kun 'byung bsam yas 'phel yid bzhin nor// dbang gi rgyal po bla ma la btud nas// mi mthun phyogs 'joms dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// 'dod pa'i rgyal po cung zad bstod par bgyi// ma lus rgyal ba'i dbang gi phrin las rnams// gcig tu bsdus nas gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir// bgegs 'joms khro bo'i dbang po skur ston pa'i// 'dod rgyal bzhir bzhugs la 'dud// shar sgor dri za'i dbang phyug gang ba bzang*// btso ma'i gser 'dra zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan// na ku li dang bī dza pū ra kas// phyag gnyis mdzes par byas la phyag 'tshal lo// lho sgor grul bum dbang sgyur nor bu bzang*// dbang sngon mdog can drag po'i nyams dang ldan// rin po che dang bī dza pū ra kas// phyag gi padma mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// nub sgor klu la dbang mdzad nor sbyin che// padma rā ga'i mdog can chags pa'i nyams// bum pa bzang dang bī dza pū ra kas// g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo// byang sgor gnod sbyin dbang po rnam thos sras// gser ri'i mdog can rgyas pa'i nyams dang ldan// rin chen myu gu bī dza pū ra kas// phyag gnyis rnam par brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// me yi mtshams su tsi pi kuṇḍa li// sgeg pa'i lus can cung zad dmar ba'i mdog

/bden bral mtshams su ke li mā la'i sku// ma ra ka tar snang la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung mtshams sgo yis dbang po mdzes pa'i sku// grub pa kun stsol gser 'od 'bar ba can// dbang ldan mtshams su spyod pa'i dbang po mchog /dkar ser kha dog can la phyag 'tshal lo// kun kyang nang gi grwa bzhir legs bzhugs shing*// phyag g.yas bī dza pū ra ka yis brgyan// g.yon pa khu tshur brla yi steng du 'gying*// sems dpa'i skyil krung mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kun mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes las// legs 'khrungs nor rgyun dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// nam mkha'i gtos kun rgyas par rab sprul nas// 'gro ba'i bsod nams rgyas mdzad la phyag 'tshal// ma lus rgyal ba'i yon tan rnam dag pa// ser sna kun sbyangs nga rgyal zad mdzad ma// rab 'byams chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /chos tshul rgyas par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// kun kyang lhun po lta bur rab brjid cing*// rgyas pa'i nyams ldan sna tshogs gos bzang can// gser 'od 'bar ba'i 'od zer stong 'phro bas// skye dgu'i dpal 'byor spel la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mo dbyig gi dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// snyan grags tshe dang dam chos rin chen gter// cho ga bzhin du dwang bas gsol 'debs kyis// dam chos phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// yul dus gnas skabs kun tu mi nyams par// phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// tshad med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i dpal mnga' zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa srog pas gces 'dzin pa'i// mtshungs med bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams// sku tshe ring zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol// 'gro la dge ba'i lam bzang snang mdzad cing*// 'chad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba lhur len pa'i// chos byed dge 'dun de dag zhabs brtan cing*// phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// mi rnams na rga 'chi ba'i 'jigs med cing*// 'jig rten yang dag lta ba dang ldan pas// phan tshun byams pa'i yid dang ldan gyur cing*// tshad med dge ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol// grong rnams 'jam pa'i rlung gis g.yo ba yi// ba dan dkar po'i phreng bas rab mdzes shing*// gos bzang rin chen rgyan dang ldan pa yi// 'byor ldan skye bos gang bar mdzad du gsol// mkha' la glog phreng 'gyu ba'i sprin mdzes shing*// sa la rma bya dga' ba'i gar mdzes pa// zim bu dal gyis 'bab pa'i char rgyun gyis// 'gro rnams dga' ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol// ri rnams rtswa dang me tog 'bab chus brgyan// klung rnams sna tshogs phyugs dang 'bru yis gang*// mi rnams rab tu dga' ba'i glu len cing*// dregs dang 'thab rtsod med par mdzad du gsol// rgyal pos chab srid zhi bas legs skyong zhing*// 'bangs rnams rgyal po'i bka' lung gus len pas// phyi dang nang gyi 'khrug rtsod nyer zhi nas// rdzogs ldan bzhin du bde bar mdzad du gsol// gtsug lag khang dang rgyal ba'i sku gzugs dang*// dam chos glegs bam du mas rab mdzes nas// lha rdzas mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dpag med kyis// mchod pa'i char chen rgyas par mdzad du gsol// dgon gnas thams cad thub bstan skyong byed pa// bshes gnyen ngur smrig 'dzin pas yongs gang ste// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' zhing*// klog dang kha ton rgyas par mdzad du gsol// dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong pha ma rnams// dri ma med pa'i tshul khrims dang ldan zhing*// rnam dag thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba yi// bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol// sgrub pa po rnams g.yeng ba kun spangs nas// 'tshe ba kun bral 'du 'dzis rab dben pa'i// zhi ba'i gnas su spong ba lhur len pa'i// rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas par mdzad du gsol// lhag par dad pas gsol ba 'debs byed pa// sgrub po bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// log 'tsho bral ba'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs dang*// tshe dang dam chos rgyas par mdzad du gsol// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab bla na med sogs kyis// rang la sangs rgyas chos kun yongs rdzogs nas// lung rtogs yon tan rgyas par mdzad du gsol// sbyin dang snyan par smra bas 'khor bsdus nas// don spyod dam chos tshul bzhin bshad pa'i mthus// rang gzhan don mthun chos la legs sbyar nas// gzhan don chos bzhin rgyas par mdzad du gsol// chos kyi 'gal rkyen mtha' dag nyer zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen ma lus phun sum tshogs gyur nas// gang dang gang la thub pas rab bsngags pa'i// dge ba de dag rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyal bas nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs mchog tu// rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang*// brtul zhugs ldan zhing shin tu mnyam gzhag pas// nyin mtshan bdun du 'phags ma bsgoms pa dang*// 'gro la phan dang bde ba'i bsam sbyor gyis// gzungs sngags cho ga bzhin du rab bzlas shing*// rgya chen mchod pa'i tshogs dang gtor ma dang*// nye bar mkho ba kun gyis legs mchod nas// mig btsum tsam la dpal mo nor rgyun mas// nor dang so ba gser dngul la sogs pa// nye bar mkho bas bang mdzod kun 'gengs shing*// nyer 'tshe kun dang bral bar 'gyur ro zhes// yang dag bka' las 'byung ba legs mthong nas// ji skad gsungs bzhin 'bad pas mchod bgyid na// byang chub bar gyi dngos grub ma lus pa// 'bad med rgyun mi chad par stsal du gsol// chang dang bsad sha gzhan phrogs nor rdzas dang*// mchod rten dkor sogs sdig pa'i longs spyod dag

/'jig rten lha mi dag gi'ang ster nus na// 'phags ma khyod la gsol ba'i dgos pa ci// ye shes spyan mnga' lha khyod gus bsten cing*// 'dod chags bral ba'i rig sngags bzlas pa'i mthus// tshul khrims dag cing bshad sgrub rgyas pa dang*// log 'tsho med pa'i phun tshogs stsal du gsol// de ltar rgyas pa'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi// yon tan rgyas par brjod pa'i dge ba des// 'gro ba kun la phan bde rab rgyas nas// chos dang dpal 'byor phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /nor rgyun dpal mo'i rig sngags mthu stobs dang*// chos kun de bzhin nyid kyi bden pa dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i mthus// ji ltar gsol ba de bzhin 'grub gyur cig /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i nor gyi rgyun ma lha bcu dgu'i bdag nyid can la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa chos dang dpal 'byor rgyas byed ces bya ba shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rgyal mtshan dpal la sogs pa nye bar gnas pa rnams kyi don du sa pho rta'i lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga'i dus 'jig rten thams cad 'bru mang po dang rtsi bcud kyis yongs su gang zhing rgyas pa'i tshe dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' legs pa'i rin chen gyis bgyis so// i daṃ sarba sa twa pu ṇya ā yur puṣṭiṃ bha bantu// // ༄// dpal ldan sa skya'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bdud las rnam rgyal bzhugs so// ༈ /dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rdo rje gur// khyab bdag ston pa kye yi rdo rje yi// sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i srung ma mchog /nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sgeg pa'i sku lus char sprin ltar gnag cing*// dpa' bo'i zhal gcig bdud 'joms mche bas spras// mi sdug phyag gnyis gri gug thod pas brel// zlum po'i stabs kyis zhabs gnyis mdzes la bstod// bzhad pa'i nga ros tshangs sogs mthar mdzad cing*// drag shul sgra yis bdud dang gshin rje 'dar// 'jigs rung gad mos klu dang 'byung po'i gdon// rab tu skrag mdzad dpa' bo che la bstod// snying rje'i thugs kyis 'gro ba'i bgegs sel zhing*// rngam pas gnod byed gdug pa can kun 'dul// zhi bas bstan pa rin chen phyogs kun du// rnam par rgyas mdzad nag po che la bstod// khyod thugs 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor las// phrin las bye ba'i 'od stong rab spros pas// nag phyogs bdud sde'i mun pa 'joms mdzad pa'i// mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal dgon che la bstod// rgyal bas sngon tshe rdo rje gur gyi rgyud// legs par gsung tshe rgyud kun bsrung ba'i phyir// nyid kyi sku las nag po khyod sprul pa'i// bde gshegs sprul sku dam tshig can la bstod// lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje nag po che// mgon po srid zhi'i dgra khyod legs mchod kyi// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje'i rgyud la sogs// gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin sbyar ro// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la bstod pa ste dang po'o//

//'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo nam gru ma// srid gsum gnas pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal ma// lha chen de bas mchod pa'i dpal ldan ma// ma lus mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bstod// dus mtshan nag mo rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i sku// rol pa'i zhabs gnyis bong bu'i gdan la bzhugs// sna tshogs mtshon chas spras pa'i phyag bzhi yis// nag phyogs phye mar 'thag mdzad khyod la bstod// khyod kyi 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe// tshangs dang lha dbang rgyal po bzhi la sogs// 'jig rten dbang po rnams kyis rab btud ma// bsam yas rdzu 'phrul mnga' bdag khyod la bstod// sngon tshe rgyal bas rnal 'byor nam mkha' yi// rnam dag dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur nas// rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud kyi srung ma ru// bka' bsgos zhal gyis bzhes pa khyod la bstod// rig pa mchog gi rgyud sde gsungs pa'i tshe// lag na rdo rjes khyod kyi cho 'brang dang*// rigs la bstod nas dpal kun 'byung ba yi// dkyil 'khor chen por bcug pa khyod la bstod// sprul sku shākya thub pa'i sbyan snga ru// khyod kyi srog gi snying po legs phul nas// bya rgyud bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs ma// phrin las lhun grub ma mo khyod la bstod// de wi ko ṭi'i zhing du gnas bcas pa'i// rdo rje lha mo nag mo khyod mchod kyis// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud la sogs// ma rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang sogs 'og ltar sbyar ro// dpal ldan lha mo la bstod pa ste gnyis pa'o// //gang gi mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis// lha min bdud kyi dpung tshogs rab bcom nas// thub bstan lha dbang grong khyer skyong mdzad pa'i// gdong pa bzhi ldan nag po che la bstod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs// srid gsum dbang phyug dregs pa kun gyi gtso// sa gsum log 'dren 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che// khams gsum gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod// las bzhi lhun grub gtum chen khyod kyi sku// zhal bzhi legs mdzes khros pas gad rgyangs sgrogs// phyag bzhi 'jigs rung tshon chas rab brgyan pa'i// bdud bzhi thal bar rlag byed khyod la bstod// brkyang bskum zhabs kyis dam nyams lus nyid cing*// rus pa'i rgyan dang er ka'i phreng ba dang*// tshangs skud dar gyi na bza' sna tshogs kyis// rab mdzes bram ze'i gzugs can khyod la bstod// sngon dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur dam tshig thob nas 'dus pa'i rgyud// dar zhing rgyas pa'i srung mar bka' bsgos pa'i// chos srung nag po chen po khyod la bstod// khyod kyi 'khor na gnas pa'i sring mo bzhi// mi srun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzin phyir// sna tshogs gzugs dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis// phrin las sna tshogs sgrub mdzad khyod la bstod// ha ha rgod pa'i gnas la rab brten pa'i// ston pa'i nying sprul zhing skyong khyod mchod kyis// dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs// pha rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang sogs 'og ltar sbyar ro// dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa ste gsum pa'o//

//nag po gnod sbyin srin po khros pa'i gzugs// g.yang gzhi'i gos gyon gser gyi rna cha g.yo// gri gug 'bar bas bdud kyi mgo gcod cing*// sbar bas dam nyams klad khrag 'dren la bstod// nag mo gnod sbyin rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i gzugs// za 'og gos gyon byi ru'i lan tshar can// gdug pa'i lus gcod spu gri rnon po dang*// bgegs kyi snying 'byin sbar ba gdengs la bstod// pu tra nag po ha ha'i bzhad sgra can// ral gri thod pas brgyan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis// gnod pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus tshar bcad nas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong mdzad khyod la bstod// bha tra nag po dar gyi stag slog can// khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i phreng bas lus mdzes zhing*// rnal 'byor bsrung phyir g.yas pas dam shing dang*// g.yon pas dgra snying 'byin mdzad khyod la bstod// sring mo nag mo gser gyi spu gri can// gdug pa can gyi rgyu mas phyag g.yon brel// khrag gi mig ldan kha nas me 'bar bas// bstan dgra thal bar sreg mdzad khyod la bstod// khyod sngon slob dpon padma byung gnas kyis// bod yul bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing*// dharma pā las rnal 'byor rgyun kun gyi// srung mar bka' bsgo mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje gdan gyi spo la gnas bcas pa'i// las mgon pho nya'i tshogs rnams gus mchod kyis// dpal ldan de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud la sogs// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang sogs 'og ltar sbyar ro// las mgon pu tra ming sring la bstod pa ste bzhi pa'o// //bstan srung mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i// rgya chen mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang cher mtho zhing*// bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe legs brtan nas// rnam dkar phrin las rgyas par mdzad du gsol// khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// tshe dang blo gros bsod nams rab rgyas nas// thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// bdag gi 'dod pa'i phrin las zhu ba ni// 'chi bdag bdud kyi bar chad kun zhi nas// rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i// bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phrin las zhu ba ste lnga pa'o//

//de ltar bstan srung 'khor bcas la// bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// 'chi bdag dgra las rnam rgyal nas// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog /ces pa 'di ni zil gnon gyi lo dbo zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rang gi 'dod pa'i phrin las zhu ba'i phyir du dpal ldan sa skyar sbyar ba'o// //'dis mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig/

༄// yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rgyas byed bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rgyas byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rje'i chu gter che las 'khrungs// byang chub sems kyi sbrang rtsi'i dog pas gtams// thabs mkhas spyod pa'i 'dab stong rab rgyas pa// rgyal ba chu skyes dbang por rab btud nas// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par bya phyir dang*// yid 'ong gzugs sku'i 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir// dam pa'i chos dang bkra shis rgyas byed lam// yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga gsal bar bshad// 'dir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag skal ba dang ldan pa dag gis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i mdo dang*/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam las gsungs pa ltar/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byed par 'dod na/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ dkon mchog gi rten na bzas brgyan pa'i spyan sngar/ mchod yon dang*// mar me dang*/ zhal zas rnams kyi phreng ba du ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ dri chab rnams ci 'byor pa bsham/ sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag rang la longs spyod gang yod kyi sum gnyis dkon mchog gi mchod pa la btang dgos par bzhed pa ltar/ longs spyod la ser sna med cing*/ gzhan gyis mthong na blo 'khul nus pa'i mchod pa bsham mo// de nas rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug la/ dkon mchog gi rten la kha phyogs pas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro bya ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes mang du brjod pa'i mthar/

sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gi skyabs gnas mthar thug pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig /chags sdang dang 'bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams nas rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs par bsams la/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar bas me tog dang bdug spos bzung la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod cing*/ dkon mchog rnams byon pa'i sngon gdong du dmigs la langs te/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// zhes pas so so'i zhing khams nas byon pa'i dkon mchog rnams mdun du mngon sum ltar du bzhugs par bsams nas/

khyed ni rang bzhin yang dag pas// sred sogs nyes pa mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyi sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub rtsol bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ rkang pa re re'i gsham du sngar gyi sngags rnams brjod cing*/ me long gi nang du dkon mchog gi rten 'char du bcug pa la/ dri bzang po'i chus khrus gsol/ de nas/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes chu'i rdul rnams dar dkar po la dri bzang gi thig le lnga'am rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pas phyi zhing*/ sku phyis bar bsgoms la/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wast+ra a laṃ ka ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ dri med mtshan la sgrib gsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /ces khrus dang gos rgyan gyi mchod pa rnams phul nas/

bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ padma tsand+ra ā sa na tiṣṭhantu swā hā/ zhes pas gdan 'bul lo// de nas rol mo dang bcas pas bskor ba bya zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ ratna ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te/ sa myaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya tha/ oṃ ratne ratne/ ma hā ratne/ ratna bi dzā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa la/ yan lag bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ sems kyis lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul pa'i lus re re la mgo dpag tu med pa/ mgo re re la'ang lce brgya stong dpag tu med par bsams la/ de thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bstod pa brjod par bsgoms la/ ngag tu/ bstod tshig rnams brjod/ lus kyi gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// mkhyen brtse yon tan phrin las ma lus pa// gcig tu bsdus nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi 'dren pa ste// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis su med// legs gsungs sgron me dam pa'i chos kyi gsung*// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /rin chen bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ri bo mi 'gyur brtan pa'i sku// gsung dbyangs thos pas mi ngoms tshangs pa'i dbyangs// ye shes rgya mtsho mi g.yo zab pa'i thugs// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul bla chen sa skya pa// bsod nams rtse mo rje btsun rin po che// chos rje paṇa chen chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs// bstan pa'i sgron me rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis bla ma rnams dang*/

tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen bzhi sku gsum grub// rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler gzigs// chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes skur ldan// sangs rgyas dpag bsam 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo// chos gnyis rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang*// chos la skye 'gags med cing spros pas dben// de la dmigs te yon tan kun 'byung ba'i// legs brgyud dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gnyen pos rim par bsal nas zhing skyong zhing*// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas sar bzhugs pa'i// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog bla med dpal mgon rin po che// dad mos rnams la yon tan bsam mi khyab// mtho dman yongs kyi skyabs gnas 'gro ba'i mgon// rin chen dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum bdag nyid thub pa'i dbang po dang*// dug gsum nad sel chags bral dam pa'i chos// bslab gsum rnam dag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs dkon mchog gsum dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*// shākya thub pa gau tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe// phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bskyab pa'i phyir// smon lam khyad par can btab 'grub gyur pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas// phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun yongs su skyob mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon gyi smon lam byang chub rjes spyad pas// mtshan tsam thos pas sgrib pa kun sel ba// phrin las mnga' ba kun mkhyen 'jig rten mgon// sangs rgyas sum cu lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing*// spyod pa spyad pa na yang mched gyur cing*// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur mdzes pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba// mgon po mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ma lus rkang gnyis gtso// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// gser gyi mdog can lha yi lhar gyur pa// dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// baiḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas rnams dang*/

smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i lam// don dam dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das// dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam kun mkhyen ngo bo nyid// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs chos dkon mchog dang*/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// byang chub spyod pa bla med mthar phyin pas// shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur pa'i// mgon po mi pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rga shi'i 'jigs spangs gzhon nur gyur pa ste// gzhan don dgyes pas 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can// sna tshogs sprul mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas pa// bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi rje// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin pa// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la nyon mongs rnams kyang bde sbyin na// gang zhig gus bcas de la ci smos pa// mthu chen sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyin dang mtshan mo de bzhin lan gsum du// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// rtag tu 'dod bzhin spyad pa spyod pa na// de dag 'khrul pa nam yang mi btsal lo// zhes sogs kyis byang sems dang*// brtse bas thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong rgyal po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba drag po sel mdzad pa// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba nyid kyang thugs rje'i dbang gis na// lha mo'i tshul ston kun tu gsal ba'i sku// yid bzhin nor bu padma legs bsnams pa// shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang klu dbang grub pa'i cod paṇa gyis// rin chen 'od zer 'phro ba gang gi zhabs// kun nas gsal bas nyi ma'ang zil gnon pa// phongs pa kun skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud// brtse bas rjes chags padma rā ga'i mdog

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// mda' gzhu atpal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin// bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir// brtse bas 'jigs byed lha mo'i skur ston nas// dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog stsol ma// sgrol ma drag mo 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// margad mdog mtshungs nyi ma lta bur gsal// nyon mongs dug 'joms rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*// dngos grub kun stsol bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin// rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar du gcod pa kun las grol mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun nas zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi// rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus// bdud bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms pa yi// rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku// ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen ston ka'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing*// dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong chem// 'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa'i// phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes las// nye bar grub pa'i mthu stobs rdo rje yis// bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms byed pa// dpal chen rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir rab khros pa// byi ru'i mdog mtshungs padma dbyug to 'dzin// rta mchog zhal gyis dgra yi dpung 'joms pa// khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul ba'i dpal las legs 'ong zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ma// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen lnga la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can// klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis 'dod lha rnams dang*// gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba// bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas// bstan pa 'dzin dang spal dang srung mdzad pa'i// dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug zhabs la 'dud// zab mo rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas// rang byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni// gtan pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa'i// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs bsrung ba'i// rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa// nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams la phyag byas la/

slar yang*/ mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis phyag bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ni/ mdun du bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams lha rdzas las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa gzhi khyab pa tsam du gyur bar bsams nas de dag dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi mchod yon la sogs pa thams cad 'bul ba'i bsam pa rtse gcig pas/ phyogs dus kun na mchod yon ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i// byang chub sems kyis sems rgyud brlan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tī tstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sngags mgo mjug gnyis po 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar la/ phyogs dus kun na me tog ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba'i 'bras 'byung ba'i// sbyin pa'i me tog phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /badzra puṣpe= phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// 'phags pa dgyes shing 'gro kun bde byed pa'i// tshul khrims dri zhim rgyun mi chad par shog /badzra dhū pe= phyogs dus kun na snang gsal ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// nyon mongs sdug bsngal mun pa kun sel ba'i// bzod pa'i sgron me rab tu rgyas par shog /badzra ā lo ke= phyogs dus kun na dri mchog ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// skyo ngal med par gzhan don la spro ba'i// brtson 'grus byug pa'i sems dang ldan par shog /badzra gandhe= phyogs dus kun na zhal zas ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// zag med bde bas lus sems tshim byed pa'i// bsam gtan zas la phyogs bcur spyod par shog

/badzra nai wi tya= phyogs dus kun na sil snyan ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// zab cing rgya che'i chos don ston pa yi// shes rab sgra snyan phyogs bcur sgrogs par shog /badzra shapta= 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*// glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen bdun// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// 'phags pa'i nor bdun rnams la spyod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sapta ma hā ratna badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na yid 'ong gzugs sgra dang*// dri ro reg bya khyad 'phags 'dod yon lnga// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i// yid 'ong mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul lags kyi// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /dad dang snying rje'i shugs kyis bdag gi lus// 'gro kun phan bde'i bya ba bsgrub slad du// dkon mchog gsum gyi bran du legs phul nas// dngos sam bsam pas gzhan don ci nus bgyi// rin chen bum pa dri zhim spos kyi chu// srab 'jam yang zhing mdzes pa lha yi gos// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan phreng yid du 'ong*// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong me tog phreng*// dri zhim nam mkha' khyab byed bdug pa'i sprin// mun sel rin chen sgron me lham me ba// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// rnam dag dbang po tshim byed dri yi mchog /kha dog dri ro nus bzang lha yi gos// rnam thar don ston glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa'i gzhal med khang*// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// bla re rgyal mtshan 'phan sogs khyad 'phags rnams// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// zhes pa'i mthar/

na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sa twa bhyaḥ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā bar ta ya/ ā bar ta ya sā hā/ zhes brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur dang*/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro// de nas maṇḍal khru gang las mi chung ba'am/ sa gzhi la me tog dang bcas pas dri bzang pos phyogs thams cad du khyab par byug cing*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rin po che'i sa gzhi dang*/ mtha' skor du byug cing*/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lcags ri'i khor yug tu bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes pas dbus su me tog dor te bsrung bar byas nas/ rang rang gi gnas rnams su me tog gam/ rin po che la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ haṃ su me ra wa na maḥ oṃ yaṃ pūrpa bi de hā ya na maḥ oṃ raṃ dzambu dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ laṃ a pa ra go dā nī ya na maḥ oṃ waṃ utta ra kur we na maḥ zhes pas/ ri yi rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzambū gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan rnams dang*/ rtsa ba'i gling rnams dang nye bar/ oṃ yaḥ.u pa dī pa ya na maḥ oṃ raḥ.u pa dī pā ya na maḥ oṃ waḥ.u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ waḥ.u pā dwī pā ya na maḥ zhes lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang*/ sgra mi snyan gyi zla rnams dang*/ de dag gi nang du/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir/ me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir rim pa bzhin/ oṃ yaḥg dza ratna ya na maḥ oṃ raḥpu ru ṣa ratna ya na maḥ oṃ laḥbā dzī ratna ya na maḥ oṃ phaḥst+rī ratna ya na maḥ oṃ yaḥkhaḍga ratna ya na maḥ oṃ raḥtsakra ratna ya na maḥ oṃ laḥm ṇi ratnā ya na maḥ oṃ waḥm hā ni dha ye na maḥ zhes pas rin po che sna bdun dang*/ gter chen po'i bum pa rnams dang*/ ri rab kyi shar dang nub tu/ oṃ aṃ sārya ya na maḥ oṃ āḥtsand+rā ya na maḥ

zhes pas nyi ma dang zla ba dag dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar dmigs la/ lhag bsam rnam dag chu gter las 'khrungs gling mang 'dab ma rab rgyas shing*// ri rab lhun po ze'u 'bru rnam mdzes nyi zla'i 'od kyi mdangs bzang can// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor dri bsung rab 'phro nam mkha'i dbyings ltar kun khyab pa'i// rin chen maṇḍal me tog mchog 'di rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// zhes pas phul nas/ don yid la sems bzhin du/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu padmas brgyan pa dang*// ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ba// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams dang*// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyis mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes bu mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis ni// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig

/rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus 'di gtan du 'bul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyod kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog mandār dang padma dang*// utpal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la 'bul bar bgyi// gser gyi padma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byug pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'chang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la 'bul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// 'khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pas yid 'ong brgyan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig

/dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces pas mchod par bya'o// gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ sngar byas pa'i nyes pa la 'gyod pa drag po dang*/ phyis mi byed pa'i sdom sems dang ldan pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas/ tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi sgo nas/ mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga dang*/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spongs pa dang*/ 'phags pa la skur ba btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid lags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so// zhes dang*/

phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas// tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag tu// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am// bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni// gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te// rjes su yi rangs gang bgyis pa// nongs pa de ni mthol bgyid nas// bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags// bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni// pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la// nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang*// yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang*// nyes pa du mas skyon chags pa'i// sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang*// shin tu mi bzad bgyid pa de// thams cad 'dren pa rnams la bshags// bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar// sngon du 'gums par 'gyur du mchi// 'di las ji ltar nges thar bar// myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di// byas dang ma byas mi sdod pas// na dang mi na kun gyis kyang*// glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan// thams cad bor te chas dgos pas// bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas// mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas// mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing*// mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur// bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba ste// de bzhin thams cad med par 'gyur// rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin// dngos po gang dang gang spyad pa// de de dran pa'i yul du 'gyur// 'das pa thams cad mthong mi 'gyur// re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la// mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das// de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas// de ltar bdag ni glo bur zhes// bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas// gti mug chags dang zhe sdang gis// sdig pa rnam pa du ma byas// nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par// tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing*// bsnon pa gud nas yong med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor kyang*// srog gcod pa yi tshor ba dag

/bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan// de tshe bsod nams gcig bskyab na// de yang bdag gis ma bsten to// mgon po bag med bdag gis ni// 'jigs pa 'di 'dra ma 'tshal nas// mi rtag tshe 'di'i ched dag tu// sdig pa mang po nye bar bsgrubs// skye bo yan lag gcod pa'i sar// de ring khrid pa'ang bred gyur te// kha skam mig rtsa ngan la sogs// snga las gzhan du 'gyur snang na// gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i// sha tshugs can gyis bzung 'gyur zhing*// 'jigs chen nad kyis thebs gyur ba// rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos// su zhig 'jigs chen 'di las bdag /legs par skyob par byed 'gyur zhes// bred sha thon pa'i mig bgrad nas// phyogs bzhir skyabs dag tshol bar byed// phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni// de nas kun tu yi mug 'gyur// gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na// de tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya// de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrags nas// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrags nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang*// sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na// 'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi// nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos// de gcig gis kyang 'dzam gling na// gnas pa'i mi kun brlag byed na// de dag gso ba'i sman gzhan ni// phyogs rnams kun nas mi rnyed na// de la sman pa thams cad mkhyen// zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa yi// bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni// shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas// g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la'ang*// bag yod gnas par bya dgos na// dpag tshad stong du lhung ba yi// yun ring g.yang sar smos ci dgos// de ring kho nar mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa'i rigs ma yin// bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus// de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung*// bdag la mi 'jigs su yis byin// 'di las ji ltar nges thar 'gyur// gdon mi za bar med 'gyur na// ji ltar bdag yid bde bar 'dug

/sngon chad myong ste zhig pa las// bdag la lhag pa ci yod na// bdag ni de la mngon zhen nas// bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal bar byas// gson tshe 'di dang de bzhin du// gnyen dang bshes pa rnams spangs nas// gcig pur ga shed 'gro dgos na// mdza' dang mi mdza' kun ci rung*// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// de las ji ltar nges thar zhes// nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'am// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin pa// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyid// ces brjod/ bzhi pa dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal bso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// zhes brjod do// lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// zhes brjod do// drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa'i yan lag ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed par// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di mdongs par mi dgod cing*// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// zhes brjod do// bdun pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/

de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji snyed pa// nad gsos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dang ni// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom pa'i gnod pa bsal// mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs shing dbul ba la// bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te// yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su// mdun na nye bar gnas gyur cig /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phongs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub// thams cad btang bar chabs cig la// sems can rnams la btang ba mchog /bdag gis lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis// rtag tu gsod dang smod pa dang*// brdeg btsog ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la rtsod byed dam// co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang*// bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis// 'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya// de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i// las gang yin pa byed du chug /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis// khro'am dad pa'i sems byung na// de nyid rtag tu de dag gis// don kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am// de bzhin phyar ka gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// mar me 'dod la mar me dang*// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog

/yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor shog /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun tu// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tshe'i rgyur yang shog /ces brjod do// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar yan lag bdun pa tshar ba'i rjes la/ dkon mchog gi yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ mdo rjes dran rnam gsum dag par bton la/ yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i dkon mchog gsum la/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ buddha sha ra ṇaṃ gatstshā mi/ dharma sha ra ṇaṃ gatstshā mi/ saṃ gha sha ra ṇaṃ gatstshā mi/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pas skyabs 'gro zhe thag pa nas byas pa'i mthar/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa/ da lta bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba dang rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa/ sems can rnams la bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs shing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgyud la skyes nas 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas te/ don gnyis phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten du char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ nad dang 'khrug pa mu ge med cing bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa/ khyad par du sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi nad dang gdon dang bar chad zhi ba tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas pa/

mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa rab spangs nas// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i sku gnyis myur thob ste// don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// rgyal khams kun tu bde skyid 'phel ba dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyis ji ltar dgongs pa'i don// rgya chen 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sbyin bdag rnams kyi chos dang mthun pa'i don// ji ltar bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa kun// nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lus can kun gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*// 'khrug long gnod 'tshe mtha' dag rab zhi nas// phan tshun phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa yis// dge legs 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phyogs rnams kun tu lo phyugs legs pa dang*// longs spyod 'phel zhing sdig pa'i las spangs nas// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems ldan pa'i// chos spyod 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkhyen rab ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas// thugs rje chen po'i phyag gis nyer bzung ste// lhun grub rgyun ldan phrin las nus mthu yis// mkha' mnyam 'gro la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes drag tu gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ ji ltar rigs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam btab la/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ der bzhugs pa'i rten rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*// bkra shis rgya cher bya'o// gal te de tsam mi nus na/ seng ge sgra nas nam mkha' lding gi bar gyi phyag 'tshal dang*/ phyogs dus kun nas bdag pos ma bzung ba'i// zhes pa nas/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i bar gyi mchod pa dang*/ yid brten mi rung 'chi bdag 'di// zhes pa nas/
